text:
Claire (Partnerships): Quick Q  can we add a micro-credential badge for SIs who complete the sandbox marketplace + private deploy labs? Would help partners show readiness.
Ibrahim (SI Program): Love that. Proposal: "Marketplace Integrator" micro-credential — short practical + checklist. Pass = complete listing + deploy a private model in sandbox with autoscaling test.
June (Training Ops): We can make the exam ~20 minutes. Need proctor checklist, VM snapshot, and a README scoring rubric. I can scaffold the rubric.
Oskar (Marketplace): Marketplace will emit a verification token when the sandbox listing passes validation. Include that in the exam as the proof artifact.
hw-bot: Partner (EdgeScale) can provide 2x A30 for the badge practical on request. Need tenant IDs 48h prior.
Claire (Partnerships): Action items: Ibrahim -> draft micro-credential criteria and sample tasks; June -> create VM + rubric; Oskar -> instrument validation-token endpoint; I'll request EdgeScale nodes and confirm announcement wording.
Ibrahim (SI Program): Draft criteria: (1) create supplier listing with localized metadata, (2) attach co-brand assets and pass asset review (internal), (3) perform a private deployment and verify autoscale, (4) provide validation token. I'll put this in the playbook under "SI Badges v0.1".
June (Training Ops): I'll add the README snippet so proctors can verify token and automated checks. Example CLI check I'll include:
```bash
# check validation token
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" https://sandbox.redwood/verify-token/$TOKEN
```
lms-bot: Badge workflow template uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/lms/badges/si-marketplace-badge-v0.1
Oskar (Marketplace): Also note: co-brand assets must be approved by partner within 48h before public listing. For the badge practical we'll accept a "partner preview" stamp.
Claire (Partnerships): If partner sign-off delays, badge still awarded if candidate demonstrates process end-to-end using preview assets and attaches proctor note.
Ibrahim (SI Program): I'll schedule a 30m pilot for 8 SIs next Tue. Will post roster today.
June (Training Ops): Proctor ratio: 1 per 8 for this badge. I'll schedule accordingly and upload the VM snapshot by EOD Fri.
Claire (Partnerships): Great. I'll draft a short partner-facing blurb for the badge and share it here for approval before announcing.
Oskar (Marketplace): Adding a small sandbox validation flag to the API to mark badge runs so they don't trigger public scans.
Ibrahim (SI Program): Roster posted, two SIs need VPN exceptions. I'll DM eng-security.
Claire (Partnerships): Closing loop: will post final checklist Wed morning. Thanks everyone :rocket:
